stop_rule: Enumerate the complete 112-port graph, use the deterministic MRV perfect matching, solve one exact 81 by 224 F2 system with highest-index pivots and free variables zero, and stop after full matrix, dirty-state, copy-rank, ceiling and negative-control checks.
